decision: Selected the centroid of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcel 259-40-091 (situs 55 S MARKET ST, SAN JOSE 95113), the parcel at the address CoreSite gives for SV1, as the site locator of CoreSite SV1. It locates the host building's parcel, not CoreSite's space within the building.
layer: County of Santa Clara Parcels (Socrata dataset ubcd-cewv on data.sccgov.org), GeoJSON in WGS84; rows carry APN, situs address and jurisdiction only (no owner fields)

computed.method: Union of the parcel polygon(s); centroid computed in EPSG:32610 (WGS 84 / UTM 10N) and returned to WGS84; EPSG:5070 and EPSG:3310 cross-checks give the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: CoreSite's Silicon Valley market page (version of 9 October 2026; Internet Archive copy of 11 October 2026 and live copy of 6 November 2026) and its SV1 page give 'CoreSite SV1 - San Jose Data Center, 55 S. Market St., San Jose, CA 95113'.

A query of the county Parcels dataset for situs house number 55 on MARKET in SAN JOSE returns exactly one parcel, 25940091 (situs street direction S, zip 95113, jurisdiction San Jose, one situs address).
excluded: No geocoder, commercial map, PeeringDB, city centre or company map pin is used.
